_comment: Canonical attribute -> icon/legend mapping. Single source of truth shared by the site and the game. Synced into site/static/ and game/static/ by shared/sync.py. Keyed by the game's lowercase attribute id; 'site_id' is the matching id used in site/static/attributes.jsonl + scores.jsonl where it differs. 'svg' is a hand-built heraldic line-icon (24x24, stroke=currentColor) used in preference to 'symbol' (the emoji fallback).
